audit_scope: GLEAM public v3 release and final source article

source_article_population.internal_consistency_note: The reported laterality counts do not reconcile arithmetically with 1,200 samples from 841 patients; no patient mapping is released, so they cannot be independently corrected.

split_method_from_source: stratified random sampling at eye level (6:2:2)
risk: Fellow eyes from a patient may occur in different partitions, creating inter-sample correlation and potentially optimistic performance. The source article states this limitation explicitly.
inference_correction: All bootstrap confidence intervals in this project are eye-sample-level, not patient-level.
